The main takeaway from our work is that
functional regularization can improve sample efficiency in deep RL, and this can be done in a controlled manner via the learned Fourier features.
functional regularization can be a powerful tool in RL, and that it can be implemented in simple ways that are compatible with existing architectures.
functional regularization can be used to improve deep RL algorithms by reducing the susceptibility of the network to noise in optimization, which is a common challenge in RL.
